summary_1line: Duryodhana persuades Dhritarashtra to invite the Pandavas to a gambling match; despite Vidura’s warnings, the king orders a grand hall built and summons Yudhishthira.

image_candidates.scene_text: Artisans hastily construct a vast crystal-arched palace with a thousand columns of gold and lapis lazuli under Dhritarashtra’s command.
Vidura stands solemn before Dhritarashtra, warning that the proposed dice match will destroy their race while the blind king hesitates.
Vidura arrives at Yudhishthira’s splendid palace and delivers the uneasy invitation to a friendly match at dice.
